title: RN Sidelines Veteran Senator Ravier in Bouches-du-Rhône for Ex-LR Candidate
detail: For the 2026 French Senate elections, the Rassemblement National has sidelined veteran senator Stéphane Ravier in Bouches-du-Rhône, instead fielding ex-LR candidate Marie-Pierre Callet. The move signals RN's mainstreaming strategy — broadening its electoral appeal by recruiting candidates from the traditional right rather than relying on hardline party figures.

media.caption: RN replaces veteran senator Ravier with ex-LR candidate in Bouches-du-Rhône for 2026 Senate race

title: France Detains Undocumented Migrants Longer But Deports Fewer, Official Data Shows
detail: New official data reveals France is holding undocumented migrants in administrative detention centres for longer periods while simultaneously deporting fewer of them. The figures highlight a growing policy gap between detention capacity use and actual enforcement of deportation orders, raising questions about the effectiveness of the government's immigration enforcement approach.

media.caption: Official data reveals France detaining migrants longer while deporting fewer
